instruction: Please enable the minimal view mode in VLC. I want a cleaner, simpler interface without the extra toolbars and controls cluttering the screen during playback.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view=1). Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric function which verifies the VLC config file. Default value is 0 (disabled), task requires changing to 1 (enabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable VLC minimal view mode
Correct getter logic: get_vlc_config properly retrieves the OS-specific VLC config file (vlcrc)
Correct metric logic: check_qt_minimal_view correctly searches for qt-minimal-view setting with proper default value handling (0=disabled, 1=enabled)
Correct expected value: Expected value '1' is semantically correct for enabling minimal view mode
Appropriate postconfig: Kills and relaunches VLC to ensure settings are written to config file before evaluation
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses rule['expected_qt_minimal_view'] when expected.type='rule'
Correct data flow: Postconfig -> Getter retrieves config file -> Metric checks qt-minimal-view=1 setting
